worked.problem: A tangent at A makes 32° with chord AB. C is on the major arc AB and D on the minor arc. A learner claims ∠ADB = 32°. Find ∠ADB and identify the missed theorem.
worked.answer: 148°; opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral
actions: Identify the marked tangent–chord angle at A as 32°.
By the alternate-segment theorem, ∠ACB = 32° because C lies on the major arc AB.
The learner transferred this value directly to D, but C and D are on opposite sides of chord AB.
∠ACB and ∠ADB are opposite cyclic angles, so ∠ADB = 180° − 32°.
Answer: ∠ADB = 148°; opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral. Check: 32° + 148° = 180°.
worked.check: Answer: ∠ADB = 148°; opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral. Check: 32° + 148° = 180°.
